name: clamp-standard-microplate-in-orbital-shaker-platform
description: Transfer an ANSI/SLAS 96-well microplate from a staging pad into a benchtop orbital shaker nest, advance the spring retaining clamp bracket across the plate rim, and toggle the front power switch to start the run before parking clear.
prompt: Seat the microplate in the orbital shaker nest, lock the retaining clamp, and turn on the shaker.

rubric.0.15: Microplate lifted clear of the staging pad (> 25 mm Z rise or > 40 mm lateral displacement)
rubric.0.35: Microplate seated flush within the orbital shaker corner registration nest (within 30 mm XY and 15 mm Z)
rubric.0.50: Spring-loaded retaining clamp bracket advanced and locked across the plate rim (travel >= 12 mm)
rubric.0.75: Front panel power rocker switch toggled to start orbital shaker (revolute tilt >= 15 deg)
rubric.1.00: Shaker started while clamped, robot grippers retracted > 50 mm clear, and apparatus held in a continuous 20-step (1.0 s) stillness dwell

failure_modes: Microplate dropped below the benchtop surface (Z < 0.75 m) permanently locks score to 0.00
Toggling the power switch before the microplate is properly seated and clamped in the nest permanently locks score to 0.00 (simulating centrifugal ejection hazard)
Failing to retract both robot arms > 50 mm clear caps the score at 0.75
